senses.gloss: हेल् 1. हेल्. See rt. हेड्, p. 1176.

हेल् 2. हेल् or हेऌ (connected with rt.
हिल्) = rt. हेड्, q. v.; cl. 1. A. हेलते, &c.,
to disregard, slight; to be angry, &c.
हेलञ्ची, f. a kind of pot-herb (= हिल-मोचि).

हेलन, अम्, n. the act of disregarding, slighting,
disrespect, contempt [cf. अव-हेलन]; sporting
amorously, wanton dalliance; [cf. rt. हिल्.]

हेला, f. disrespect, contempt [cf. अव-हेला]; wan-
ton sport, amorous dalliance, manner or gesture of
lovers, play, sport, pastime, pleasure, delight, (हेलया,
inst. c. sportively, out of mere sport or pastime, for
amusement); facility, ease, (हेलया, with the greatest
ease, easily, at once); moonlight; pausing in a note
or shaking as in music.
—हेला-राज, अस्, m., N. of
a commentator.

1. हेलि, इस्, f. dalliance, wanton sport, amorous
embrace.

हेलि 2. हेलि, इस्, m. (probably borrowed fr.
Gr. ἥλιος), the sun.
हेलित, अस्, आ, अम्, disregarded, neglected, slighted.

हेलावुक्क हेलावुक्क, अस्, m. (= हेडावुक्क),
a horse-dealer, horse-seller.

हेलु हेलु, N. of a village in Kaśmīra.
—हेलु-ग्राम, अस्, m. the village Helu.
—हेलु-
दिण्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (दिण्ण Prākṛt for दत्त), pre-
sented with (the village) Helu, having received Helu
as a present.
